description: Checks that hold for any model and card: no failed requests in any item, and warnings for the hottest DIMM and for low free RAM. Speed, latency and component temperatures depend on the model and placement, so they are reported, not judged. dimm_temperature_c reads the BMC samples (bmc-telemetry.jsonl): at 66 °C on the hottest DIMM the BMC silently caps memory bandwidth to a third.
